data_origin: GitHub Actions hosted CI; these measurements are not physical user-device submissions.
limits: The accepted PR head changes one test fixture only. The CI merge checkout also includes later main documentation and physical-device report files, with no runtime, harness, build, workflow or test difference from the accepted head.

The source manifest and reconstructed worker fingerprints are checked against the immutable integrated runtime commit; API compare records establish runtime equivalence to the accepted head and actual merge checkout.

Reported pair-error maxima come from source-verified CI harnesses. Raw spectra and native binary payloads are not present in these archives; output-hash equality and recorded build/run binary-hash alignment were independently checked.
JUnit subsets overlap the full suite. Counts are per job and per XML, not additional distinct tests.
The full native architecture comparison retains its older 8bfbf2b0648e6b328df04be434c376dbc8de71a4 baseline. No fast.8-to-fast.9 native speedup is inferred from that gate.

The small packed-phase and full-versus-packed CI comparisons use different baselines and are kept separate. No performance threshold, out-of-RAM performance, billion-sample result or physical-device speedup follows from this validation.
The real macOS USS AccessDenied result is observed, not inferred. Supervised portable cases are RAM cases, so their zero Disk-RSS-fallback counters do not claim a real supervised Disk fallback run.

Build-record file labels omit temporary runner directory components. Exact archive identities and selected member digests permit retrieval of the original evidence without publishing runner paths or raw logs.
